subject: MSA/Order Form: certificate & endorsement sequencing
messages:
From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@helio-cloud.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@helio-cloud.com
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA / Order Form - COI + endorsement questions

Connor / Redwood team,

Thanks for the updated drafts. Legal at HelioCloud had a couple of quick asks before we can finalize signature routing:

- Can you confirm the minimum limits Redwood will carry for Cyber and General Liability on the Order Form exhibit? We typically require evidence at 1M/2M/2M but are open if you have a higher standard.
- We need Additional Insured wording on the policy endorsement naming HelioCloud, Inc. as an additional insured for work performed under the Order Form. Can you provide sample endorsement language or confirm your broker can issue it?
- In the meantime, is a Certificate of Insurance acceptable to route for signature with a follow-up endorsement to be delivered within 30 days? Our procurement team permits a COI + endorsement commitment if the endorsement is backstopped.

Attached is our contracting team's COI checklist (see attachment stub). If you can route a clean Order Form + COI, we can move to signature while your broker works the endorsement.

Thanks,
Emma Collins
Sr. Contracts Manager
HelioCloud

Attachment: HelioCloud_COI_Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@helio-cloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form - COI + endorsement questions

Emma — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- Coverage minimums: Our standard Order Form Exhibit specifies GL: $1,000,000 each occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate; Cyber: $2,000,000 — Ill confirm exact language with Legal but those are the baseline we can commit to on this deal.
- Additional Insured: we can accept the HelioCloud additional insured naming on the General Liability via endorsement. Our broker typically issues an endorsement that mirrors the Addl Insured language in the exhibit; I will request the insurers sample endorsement and share.
- COI as interim: yes — we can provide a Certificate of Insurance to allow signature with an endorsement to follow within 30 calendar days. We will mark the DocuSign envelope with a note and track delivery.

Laura / David — can you: 
  1) Review the attached OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (Ive attached our latest redline) and confirm the exhibit wording for limits and "Additional Insured" clause;
  2) Pull a sample endorsement or a broker confirmation we can send to Helio;
  3) Confirm whether Finance needs the exact legal entity for billing on the Order Form (Helio asked about this below).

Emma — Ill follow up once Legal confirms the exhibit text and we have a stub COI to share. Aim to have a COI + Order Form ready for your procurement team by Monday EOD.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form - COI + endorsement questions

Connor — reviewed the redline and adding the legal/insurance perspective here. Summary and proposed sequencing so the deal does not stall: 

1) Exhibit: Acceptable limits
   - Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 each occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate (we can hold at this level).
   - Professional Liability / Errors & Omissions: if the Order Form exhibit references E&O, we should require $2,000,000.
   - Cyber / Privacy Liability: $2,000,000.

2) Additional Insured language
   - We will permit HelioCloud to be named as Additional Insured on the GL policy for liabilities arising out of our work. Exact clause: "Redwood Inference agrees to procure an endorsement naming HelioCloud, Inc. as an Additional Insured for liability arising out of Redwood's performance under this Order Form."
   - Ask our broker for the ISO LLL endorsement equivalent — if they provide non-ISO language, require a brief broker attestation that the endorsement provides comparable coverage.

3) Interim COI process (recommended)
   - Provide a Certificate of Insurance that shows the required limits and lists HelioCloud as a certificate holder.
   - In the Order Form or in a cover email, include a commitment: endorsement to be delivered within 30 days of signature ("endorsement commitment clause").
   - Legal to track endorsement delivery as a post-signature obligation; Procurement can accept this workflow if documented.

4) Signer & billing entity
   - Finance asked that the Order Form explicitly contain the billing/legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: XX-XXXXXXX). Confirm with Helio whether they need a specific sub-entity named for invoicing.

Action items for Connor:
- Send COI_Sample.pdf (COI shows our limits and lists HelioCloud as certificate holder).
- Ask broker for sample endorsement or attestation and forward to contracts@helio-cloud.com.
- Add short endorsement commitment sentence to the Order Form before routing to DocuSign.

Ive attached a COI sample and added a one-line commitment in the redline. Kimberly, please weigh in if the endorsement language needs tightening.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: COI_Sample.pdf (application/pdf); OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (updated)

Emma — were aligned and ready to move forward. Summary of agreed approach and next steps: 

- Limits confirmed: GL 1M/2M, Cyber 2M (E&O 2M where referenced).
- We will provide a current Certificate of Insurance (attached) that lists HelioCloud as certificate holder. That COI will permit you to proceed to signature.
- Redline: I have added a single-sentence endorsement commitment to the Order Form (see OrderForm_v3_redline.docx). The commitment says the endorsement naming HelioCloud as Additional Insured will be delivered within 30 days of signature.
- Broker ask: our broker will either provide the endorsement PDF or a broker attestation confirming equivalent coverage. We will push to get that within 10 business days of signature.

Please confirm that HelioCloud is comfortable with the COI + endorsement-commitment flow and, if so, we will route the DocuSign envelope today. Ill include the DocuSign link in the envelope notes and tag the deal in HubSpot (DEAL-4382).

Thanks for the quick turnaround — looking forward to closing this week.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
